# agg_growth_channel_metrics_daily

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_growth_channel_metrics_daily` · dbt area: `growth`

Daily aggregate of growth funnel metrics by country and attribution channel. Metrics include spend, impressions, sessions, and leads at each funnel stage (first known through sign-up). Each row is a date-channel combination. Includes both How Heard (from application) and Last Click (from GA) attribution tiers. Sessions are attributed via GA channel_grouping and the tier_map lookup. Leads at first_known_date use last-click tiers (which may change at application). Tier 4 (adset/ad group) is available for Meta on both spend and last-click sides, parsed from UTM campaign values. Sourced from Google Analytics, Hubspot, various Marketing Spend platforms, and the Portal database.
